_comment: The Saving Journal's report insights (core/savoring_report.py). Each is a pattern in what she recorded, shown only once there are enough moments (MIN_FOR_INSIGHTS) and its own minimum behind it. Never a cause, never a should. {placeholders} are filled in by the code.
locked: Keep savoring to unlock insights: {n} more moment{s} will show your patterns.

insights.lift_up: Your mood tended to be higher after savoring (about +{lift} on average).
insights.lift_same: Your mood before and after tended to be about the same. Noticing a good moment still counts.
insights.technique: "{technique}" tended to go with a bigger lift ({lift} on average, against {overall} overall).
insights.category: Moments about "{category}" tended to lift your mood the most.
insights.anticipation_better: Things you looked forward to tended to turn out better than you expected ({actual} against {expected}).
insights.anticipation_same: Things you looked forward to tended to turn out about as good as you expected.
insights.anticipation_less: Things you looked forward to tended to turn out a little less good than you expected ({actual} against {expected}); looking forward to them still counts.
insights.weeks_higher: Weeks with more savoring days tended to have a higher check-in mood ({more} against {fewer} out of 5). This is a pattern, not a cause.
insights.weeks_lower: Weeks with more savoring days tended to have a lower check-in mood ({more} against {fewer} out of 5). This is a pattern, not a cause.
insights.time_of_day: You savored most often in the {part}.
insights.emotion: "{emotion}" was the feeling you named most.

empty_section: No savoring entries in this period
